textRuns.value: Private and NHS are invoiced figures and reconcile to the practice sheet within a few per cent. Plan capitation is RECONSTRUCTED from clinical evidence, not collected income, and it is credited to each patient’s current dentist for the whole of history — so months before a list changed hands will not match a pay sheet. The cross-charge values hygienist visits at the plan rate held in the warehouse. Cost of sales and payments for seeing another dentist’s plan patients are not held in any system we read.
